description: This file implements a geocoding client with environment-aware base URL and mock fallback. It provides functions for feature flags, URL building, normalization of geocode results, and querying geocode data either from a backend API or mock data. It exports functions for feature flags and geocode querying.

methods.name: getGeocodeFeatureFlags
methods.description: Returns feature flags parsed from environment variables for geocoding feature toggles.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on the base API URL and a given path with query.

methods.name: normalizeGeocodeItem
methods.description: Normalizes a geocoding result item into a standard format with id, name, state, country, lat, lon, label.

methods.name: normalizeGeocodeResponse
methods.description: Normalizes a geocoding response data into an array of standardized geocode items.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash code from a string, used for mock data generation.

methods.name: mockGeocode
methods.description: Provides deterministic mock geocode suggestions based on a query.

methods.name: geocodeQuery
methods.description: Performs an autocomplete geocoding lookup, either via API or mock data, returning an array of geocode items.
